figure_override.reason: DocLayout-YOLO classifies entire scene photographs as 'figure' (66.2% flagged). Scene text images are photographs themselves, not documents with embedded figures. 'has_figure' in our schema means embedded charts/diagrams within a document, not the image content itself.

empty_layout_inspection.conclusion: Empty layout_detections are EXPECTED for scene text. DocLayout-YOLO is optimized for document pages, not scene text signs/banners. 12.7% empty rate is acceptable.

results.reason: German Sparkasse banking ad (Kwitt). FIN correct (financial), but language is German not English. Parser maps 'Latin' -> 'en' regardless of actual European language.
German doctors sign (Ärzte Schloßstraße 111). MED correct (medical), but language is German not English.
French Maserati brochure. ADM questionable (automotive marketing), language is French not English.
Japanese grocery store with 金曜日定休日 (closed Fridays) + prices. FIN reasonable (retail), ja correct.
French park signs (Patrimoine arboré / Gestion differenciée). ADM correct (municipal), but language is French not English.

passing_sample_validation.conclusion: Domain assignments are generally reasonable. Key systematic issue: MLT19 parser groups all Latin-script European languages (French, German, Italian) under 'Latin' class, which maps to 'en' (English). This is a KNOWN PARSER LIMITATION, not an integration bug.
passing_sample_validation.known_issue: KI-NEW: Parser 'Latin' language class maps French/German/Italian to 'en'. Affects ~2671 train samples (13.6% of dataset). Fix would require VLM or secondary language detection to distinguish European languages within Latin script.
